title: Deprecate replaced normahq packages on npm in favor of baldaworks packages
description: Deprecate all replaced @normahq npm packages (@normahq/acp-dump, @normahq/acp-repl, @normahq/mcp-dump and their platform packages) with deprecation notices pointing to their @baldaworks replacements.
design:
### Architecture and Design
1. Deprecation Target Matrix:
   - @normahq/acp-dump + platform packages (darwin-x64, darwin-arm64, linux-x64, linux-arm64, win32-x64) -> @baldaworks/acpdump
   - @normahq/acp-repl + platform packages (darwin-x64, darwin-arm64, linux-x64, linux-arm64, win32-x64) -> @baldaworks/acpchat
   - @normahq/mcp-dump + platform packages (darwin-x64, darwin-arm64, linux-x64, linux-arm64, win32-x64) -> @baldaworks/mcpdump
2. Execution:
   - Run npm deprecate for all versions with appropriate guidance message.
3. Verification:
   - Verify npm view <pkg> 'deprecated' field for all 18 packages.

title: Rebrand normahq/mcp-dump to baldaworks/mcpdump and release to GitHub and npm
description: Rebrand normahq/mcp-dump Go module, CLI entrypoint, Taskfile, omnidist configuration, workflows, documentation, and directory to baldaworks/mcpdump. Create GitHub repository baldaworks/mcpdump, push main branch, and publish release to GitHub Releases and npm.
design:
### Architecture and Design
1. Module and Codebase:
   - Module: github.com/baldaworks/mcpdump in go.mod
   - Go toolchain: 1.26.6 with clean govulncheck
   - Directory cmd/mcp-dump -> cmd/mcpdump
   - Cobra CLI usage: mcpdump [--json] -- <mcp-server-cmd> [args...]
   - Implementation client name in internal/apps/mcpdump: mcpdump
2. Distribution:
   - Taskfile: BINARY_NAME=mcpdump, MAIN_PATH=./cmd/mcpdump
   - Omnidist: profile mcpdump, package @baldaworks/mcpdump, repo git+https://github.com/baldaworks/mcpdump.git
   - Workflows: omnidist-release.yml with bin stripping script, NPM_PUBLISH_TOKEN secret
3. Git and GitHub:
   - Create repo baldaworks/mcpdump, configure origin remote, rename folder to /home/bigboss/Projects/mcpdump
4. Release:
   - Tag v1.0.1 and publish to GitHub Releases and npm
acceptance_criteria:
- Go module renamed to github.com/baldaworks/mcpdump and Go toolchain / dependencies pass tests, lint, and govulncheck.
- CLI entrypoint moved to cmd/mcpdump and binary/command usage updated to mcpdump.
- Taskfile and omnidist configuration updated for mcpdump and @baldaworks/mcpdump.
- GitHub workflows updated for release packaging (with platform bin stripping and npm publish token secret).
- Documentation in README.md and AGENTS.md updated to baldaworks/mcpdump.
- GitHub repository baldaworks/mcpdump created, remote updated, and directory renamed to /home/bigboss/Projects/mcpdump.
- Release v1.0.1 tagged, pushed, and verified on GitHub Releases and npm registry via npx.
close_reason: Acceptance met: Rebranding to baldaworks/mcpdump complete, repository created and pushed, release v1.0.1 published to GitHub Releases and npm registry with working npx execution.
